intro: Meddlesome Mages centers on rising friction in the Shen'dar Highlands, where apprentices of the High Order trespass near sacred standing stones. Local guardians must drive them away to protect the delicate mystical forces that hold their island together from reckless arcane tampering.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.
I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do what must be done, adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Direct conflict with our shen'dorei brothers and sisters only weakens us as a people, but decisive action must at times be taken to prevent greater tragedy.

The mages of the High Order have zero regard for the consequences of their magical meddling. The forces that bind our island are fragile and vulnerable and all it could take is one thoughtless action to destroy our home.
